teachers.name: Manisha
teachers.subject: Yoga
teachers.description: Yoga cultivates self-worth and peace. Gentle Hatha and Vinyasa sessions for every level.
teachers.bio: I have been practising yoga for over fifteen years and teaching for eight. My classes blend breath work, mobility and mindful movement so you leave calmer and stronger than you arrived. I work with complete beginners, desk workers with stiff backs and people returning after injury.
teachers.teachingStyle: Slow, breath-led sessions with clear alignment cues. Every class ends with a short guided relaxation.

teachers.name: Gunjan
teachers.subject: Guitar
teachers.description: Learn guitar and ukulele online from a professional performing musician.
teachers.bio: I am a session guitarist and live performer who has toured with three indie bands. I started teaching to share the shortcuts I wish someone had shown me. We will learn songs you actually like from week one, and build technique and theory around them.
teachers.teachingStyle: Song-first learning. Each class has one technique goal, one song section and a short practice plan for the week.

teachers.name: Khushi
teachers.subject: Mathematics
teachers.description: Math coach for school boards and competitive exams like JEE and Olympiads.
teachers.bio: I help students stop being afraid of maths. I break every topic into small, visual steps and we practise until it feels obvious. Most of my students come to me for CBSE, ICSE or JEE preparation.
teachers.teachingStyle: Concept first, then lots of guided practice. I share worksheets after every class.

teachers.name: Arjun
teachers.subject: Python
teachers.description: Backend engineer teaching Python from zero to real projects and interviews.
teachers.bio: I write Python for a living at a fintech company in Hyderabad. I teach the way I learnt on the job: by building small, useful projects. Beginners finish with a portfolio, and experienced students get interview-ready.
teachers.teachingStyle: Live coding together, then you drive. Homework is a small project each week.

teachers.name: Ananya
teachers.subject: UI/UX Design
teachers.description: Product designer helping you learn Figma, design thinking and build a portfolio.
teachers.bio: I design mobile apps at a Bengaluru startup. In our classes you will learn research, wireframing, visual design and prototyping in Figma, and finish with two case studies for your portfolio.
teachers.teachingStyle: Project-based with honest design critiques every week.

teachers.name: Rahul
teachers.subject: Photography
teachers.description: Travel and portrait photographer teaching camera basics, lighting and editing.
teachers.bio: I shoot travel stories and portraits across Rajasthan. Classes happen in person around Jaipur so you can practise light and composition in real locations. We also cover Lightroom editing.
qualifications: Diploma in Photography, Light & Life Academy
teachers.teachingStyle: Hands-on photo walks with a review session after each one.

teachers.name: Meera
teachers.subject: Public Speaking
teachers.description: Speak with confidence in interviews, presentations and on stage.
teachers.bio: I am a former radio host and a corporate communication trainer. I help students and professionals overcome stage fear, structure their ideas and deliver them with presence.
qualifications: MA Mass Communication, University of Madras
teachers.teachingStyle: Short talks recorded in class, then feedback you can act on immediately.

teachers.name: Aarav
teachers.subject: Excel
teachers.description: Excel from formulas to dashboards for students, analysts and small businesses.
teachers.bio: I am a financial analyst who lives in spreadsheets. I teach Excel through real datasets: sales reports, budgets and attendance sheets. You will learn formulas, pivot tables, charts and automation.
teachers.teachingStyle: Practical and fast-paced. Every class uses a real business file.

teachers.name: Priya
teachers.subject: Piano
teachers.description: Classical and contemporary piano for children and adults, with exam prep.
teachers.bio: I trained in Western classical piano and have prepared over a hundred students for Trinity and ABRSM exams. I also teach pop and film music for those who just want to play for fun.
qualifications: LTCL Piano Performance, Trinity College London
teachers.teachingStyle: Patient and structured. Short daily practice routines that fit busy schedules.

teachers.name: Karan
teachers.subject: Digital Marketing
teachers.description: Run real campaigns: SEO, social media ads, email and analytics.
teachers.bio: I lead growth at a D2C brand. I teach the marketing that actually moves numbers: search, paid social, email and analytics. You will run a small live campaign as part of the course.
teachers.teachingStyle: Case studies and live dashboards rather than slides.

teachers.name: Sneha
teachers.subject: Machine Learning
teachers.description: ML engineer teaching machine learning, deep learning and GenAI with projects.
teachers.bio: I build recommendation systems at a large tech company. I teach the maths intuitively and focus on building: from regression to neural networks to working with LLM APIs.
teachers.teachingStyle: Intuition first, then code in notebooks together.

teachers.name: Rohan
teachers.subject: Video Editing
teachers.description: Edit YouTube videos, reels and short films in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.
teachers.bio: I edit for creators with over a million subscribers. I will teach you cutting for pace, colour, sound and the workflow tricks that save hours.
qualifications: Diploma in Film Editing, Whistling Woods
teachers.teachingStyle: Bring your own footage and we edit it together.

teachers.name: Ishita
teachers.subject: Creative Writing
teachers.description: Published author helping you write fiction, poetry and personal essays.
teachers.bio: I have published two short story collections and teach writing workshops in the hills. I help you find your voice, finish drafts and edit them into something you are proud of.
teachers.teachingStyle: Gentle workshops with prompts, reading and line-by-line feedback.

teachers.name: Vikram
teachers.subject: Entrepreneurship
teachers.description: Two-time founder mentoring on ideas, validation, pitching and early growth.
teachers.bio: I have built and sold two startups. I mentor students and first-time founders on finding a real problem, validating it cheaply, building an MVP and pitching to investors.
teachers.teachingStyle: Mentoring conversations focused on your idea and your next step.

teachers.name: Nisha
teachers.subject: Singing
teachers.description: Hindustani classical, Bollywood and western vocals with breath and pitch training.
teachers.bio: I trained in Hindustani classical music for eighteen years and perform at concerts across North India. I teach pitch, breath control and expression, whatever style you want to sing.
teachers.teachingStyle: Warm-ups, riyaz and one song each month.

teachers.name: Siddharth
teachers.subject: Drums
teachers.description: Rock, funk and jazz drumming with solid fundamentals and groove.
teachers.bio: I play drums with a Shillong rock band and teach rudiments, timing and groove for every style.
teachers.teachingStyle: Play-along tracks and a metronome. Lots of fun, lots of repetition.

teachers.name: Dev
teachers.subject: Web Development
teachers.description: Build websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React from scratch.
teachers.bio: Full-stack developer teaching beginner-friendly web development with lots of small projects.
teachers.teachingStyle: Build one small page every class.

teachers.name: Kavya
teachers.subject: Drawing
teachers.description: Sketching and pencil drawing for beginners of all ages.
teachers.bio: Fine arts graduate teaching observational drawing, shading and perspective.
qualifications: BFA, RLV College of Music and Fine Arts
teachers.teachingStyle: Draw from real objects with step-by-step demos.

teachers.name: Rhea
teachers.subject: JavaScript
teachers.description: Frontend developer teaching JavaScript, React and modern web development.
teachers.bio: I build web apps for a product startup in Pune. I teach JavaScript from the basics to async code and React, always by building small projects you can put in your portfolio.
teachers.teachingStyle: Build-along sessions with a mini project every week.

teachers.name: Aditya
teachers.subject: Java
teachers.description: Java backend engineer teaching core Java, OOP, Spring Boot and interview prep.
teachers.bio: I write Java microservices at a fintech company. I teach Java the way it is used at work: clean OOP, collections, Spring Boot and the data-structure questions interviewers love.
teachers.teachingStyle: Concept, code, then a practice problem every class.

teachers.name: Tanvi
teachers.subject: Data Science
teachers.description: Data scientist teaching analysis, statistics and visualisation with real datasets.
teachers.bio: I analyse customer data for an e-commerce company. Together we clean messy data, find insights with Python and SQL, and present them in clear dashboards.
teachers.teachingStyle: Every class works on a real dataset from start to finish.

teachers.name: Varun
teachers.subject: Generative AI
teachers.description: Build apps with LLMs: prompting, APIs, RAG and AI agents.
teachers.bio: I build AI features for a SaaS company. I teach how large language models work in plain language and how to build useful tools with them.
qualifications: B.Tech AI & Data Science, Anna University
teachers.teachingStyle: Hands-on: you ship a small AI app by the end of the month.

teachers.name: Pooja
teachers.subject: Cloud Computing
teachers.description: AWS-certified cloud engineer teaching cloud basics, DevOps and certification prep.
teachers.bio: I design cloud infrastructure for enterprise clients. I help students understand servers, storage, networking and security in the cloud, and prepare for AWS exams.
teachers.teachingStyle: Live demos in a real cloud console.

teachers.name: Kabir
teachers.subject: Graphic Design
teachers.description: Logos, posters and social media design with Illustrator, Photoshop and Canva.
teachers.bio: I am a brand designer who has worked with agencies in Mumbai. I teach layout, colour, typography and the software skills to bring ideas to life.
qualifications: BFA Applied Art, Sir J.J. School of Art
teachers.teachingStyle: Design briefs from real clients, with honest critique.

teachers.name: Sana
teachers.subject: Painting
teachers.description: Watercolour and acrylic painting for complete beginners and hobbyists.
teachers.bio: I am a practising painter who exhibits in Lucknow and Delhi. I teach colour mixing, brush control and composition at a relaxed pace.
teachers.teachingStyle: Paint-along sessions; you finish a piece every class.

teachers.name: Nikhil
teachers.subject: Animation
teachers.description: 2D and 3D animation, Blender and motion graphics.
teachers.bio: I animate for ads and short films. I teach the principles of animation first, then 3D modelling and animation in Blender.
teachers.teachingStyle: One short animation project per month.

teachers.name: Aisha
teachers.subject: Keyboard
teachers.description: Keyboard for beginners: chords, Bollywood songs and music theory.
teachers.bio: I teach keyboard to children and adults. You will play your favourite songs within weeks and learn to read music along the way.
teachers.teachingStyle: Fun, song-based lessons with weekly practice goals.

teachers.name: Harsh
teachers.subject: Flute
teachers.description: Bansuri flute in the Hindustani classical tradition.
teachers.bio: I learned bansuri in the guru-shishya tradition and perform at concerts across India. I teach breath control, ragas and light classical tunes.
teachers.teachingStyle: Calm, traditional teaching with daily riyaz plans.

teachers.name: Dhruv
teachers.subject: Music Production
teachers.description: Produce your own tracks: FL Studio, mixing, beat making and DJing.
teachers.bio: I produce music for indie artists and DJ at clubs in Mumbai. I teach production from the first beat to a finished, mixed track.
qualifications: Diploma in Music Production, True School of Music
teachers.teachingStyle: You finish one track a month with my feedback.

teachers.name: Leela
teachers.subject: Leadership
teachers.description: Leadership coaching for new managers, team leads and student leaders.
teachers.bio: I led teams at two multinational companies before becoming a certified coach. I help people lead with clarity, give feedback and manage their time.
teachers.teachingStyle: Coaching conversations built around your real situations.

teachers.name: Raghav
teachers.subject: Interview Skills
teachers.description: Crack placements: mock interviews, resume reviews and career planning.
teachers.bio: I spent eight years hiring engineers at tech companies. Now I help students prepare for placements with mock interviews, resume reviews and a clear plan.
teachers.teachingStyle: Mock interviews with detailed feedback after each one.

teachers.name: Fatima
teachers.subject: Debate
teachers.description: Debate, critical thinking and confident speaking for students.
teachers.bio: I was a national-level debater and now coach school and college teams. I teach how to build arguments, think on your feet and speak with confidence.
teachers.teachingStyle: Practice debates every class with structured feedback.

teachers.name: Sameer
teachers.subject: Financial Analysis
teachers.description: Financial statements, valuation and investing basics explained simply.
teachers.bio: I am a CFA charterholder working in equity research. I teach how to read company financials, build simple models and invest sensibly.
teachers.teachingStyle: Case studies on real Indian companies.

teachers.name: Neha
teachers.subject: Project Management
teachers.description: Agile, Scrum and product management for beginners and PMP aspirants.
teachers.bio: I manage software projects at an IT company. I teach planning, Agile and Scrum, and the basics of product and business analysis.
teachers.teachingStyle: Templates and real project scenarios you can reuse at work.

teachers.name: Yash
teachers.subject: SEO
teachers.description: Rank higher on Google: SEO, content writing and copywriting.
teachers.bio: I run SEO for e-commerce brands. I teach keyword research, on-page SEO and writing content that both people and search engines like.
teachers.teachingStyle: We optimise a real website together.

teachers.name: Maya
teachers.subject: Storytelling
teachers.description: Storytelling for writers, speakers and brands — plus songwriting basics.
teachers.bio: I write for theatre and run storytelling workshops in Goa. I help you shape ideas into stories that people remember.
teachers.teachingStyle: Writing prompts, sharing and gentle feedback.

teachers.name: Ritu
teachers.subject: Study Skills
teachers.description: Study smarter: memory techniques, time management and exam strategy.
teachers.bio: I am an educator and learning coach. I teach students how to plan, remember what they study and stay calm in exams.
teachers.teachingStyle: Practical techniques you try during the class.

teachers.name: Imran
teachers.subject: Saxophone
teachers.description: Saxophone for beginners: tone, technique and jazz standards.
teachers.bio: I play saxophone in a Kolkata jazz band. I teach breathing, tone and reading, and get you playing your first jazz standard quickly.
qualifications: Diploma in Western Music, Calcutta School of Music
teachers.teachingStyle: Play-along tracks and lots of encouragement.

teachers.name: Shreya
teachers.subject: C/C++
teachers.description: C and C++ for college students: pointers, OOP and DSA made easy.
teachers.bio: I teach programming to first-year engineering students. I make pointers, memory and data structures click with diagrams and lots of practice.
teachers.teachingStyle: Whiteboard explanations followed by coding practice.

teachers.name: Om
teachers.subject: App Development
teachers.description: Build Android and iOS apps with Flutter and Firebase.
teachers.bio: I have published several apps on the Play Store. I teach you to design, build and publish your own mobile app.
teachers.teachingStyle: You build and publish one app step by step.

teachers.name: Aditi
teachers.subject: Calligraphy
teachers.description: Modern and brush calligraphy for journals, cards and lettering.
teachers.bio: I run a small lettering studio and teach modern calligraphy workshops for beginners.
teachers.teachingStyle: Drills first, then words and layouts.

teachers.name: Farhan
teachers.subject: Cybersecurity
teachers.description: Ethical hacking, network security and CTF preparation.
teachers.bio: Security analyst at a SOC. I teach practical security with hands-on labs.
teachers.teachingStyle: Lab-based learning in safe practice environments.

teachers.name: Lakshmi
teachers.subject: Violin
teachers.description: Carnatic and western violin for beginners and intermediates.
teachers.bio: Concert violinist teaching Carnatic and western violin.
teachers.teachingStyle: Traditional structure with modern practice tools.

teachers.name: Neil
teachers.subject: Power BI
teachers.description: Power BI dashboards, DAX and data modelling for analysts.
teachers.bio: BI developer building dashboards for manufacturing companies.
qualifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst
teachers.teachingStyle: Real datasets and step-by-step dashboard builds.

teachers.name: Zoya
teachers.subject: Copywriting
teachers.description: Write copy that sells: ads, landing pages and emails.
teachers.bio: Freelance copywriter for D2C brands and startups.
teachers.teachingStyle: Rewrite real ads together and learn why the changes work.

teachers.name: Mohit
teachers.subject: SEO
teachers.description: SEO basics for bloggers.
teachers.bio: Blogger sharing SEO tips.
teachers.teachingStyle: Informal sessions.
